inventory.ordering: Deterministic filename order from pinned inventory; not historical execution proof.

sourceReviewMethod: Human review of source excerpts plus extraction of schema-qualified identifier tokens from the exact source bodies. No PostgreSQL parser, AST, name resolver, catalog snapshot, or PostgreSQL execution was used.
migrationVersionPolicy: A migration version is not a source identity. Source identity is the exact path plus pinned Git blob SHA-1. The two 202607260007 sources are distinct entries and must never be merged.
objectReferencePolicy: Qualified tokens are lexical observations, not resolved PostgreSQL object identities. Unqualified references, overloads, dynamic SQL, search_path effects, and extension-owned objects are not resolved.
executionPolicy: No migration execution or historical execution is inferred from source, hashes, preflight guards, filename ordering, or comments.

entries.referenceInterpretation: Lexically observed qualified tokens only; token may name a relation, routine, type, namespace, catalog object, or function argument. No AST, overload resolution, object-kind resolution, or dependency edge is asserted.
